in_hebrew.name: מאכסיליאנוס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Maximilianus is derived from the Latin name Maximus, which means 'greatest' or 'maximum'. The Hebrew equivalent of this name would be 'Machsiyahu' or 'Machsiel', which means 'Who is like God?' or 'God is my helper', respectively.

in_greek.name: Μαξιμιανός
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Maximilianus in Greek is Μαξιμιανός, derived from the Latin name Maximus. In Greek, it means 'greatest' or 'maximum'. This name was common among the early Christians and was borne by several saints.

in_latin.name: Maximilianus
in_latin.long_meaning: Maximilianus is a Latin name derived from the adjective maximus, meaning 'greatest' or 'maximum'. It is a masculine name and was commonly used among the ancient Romans and early Christians.
